budget_reservations_conciliada.name: budget_reservations_conciliada
budget_reservations_conciliada.value: "budget_reservations"."state" <> 'conciliada' OR ("budget_reservations"."actual_microusd" IS NOT NULL AND "budget_reservations"."generation_id" IS NOT NULL)

ad_formats_preco_coerente.name: ad_formats_preco_coerente
ad_formats_preco_coerente.value: ("ad_formats"."preco_tipo" = 'verba_mais_taxa' AND "ad_formats"."preco_valor_brl" IS NULL AND "ad_formats"."taxa_pct" IS NOT NULL) OR ("ad_formats"."preco_tipo" <> 'verba_mais_taxa' AND "ad_formats"."preco_valor_brl" IS NOT NULL AND "ad_formats"."preco_valor_brl" >= 0)

ad_slots_reservavel_completo.name: ad_slots_reservavel_completo
ad_slots_reservavel_completo.value: "ad_slots"."limite_cotas" IS NULL OR "ad_slots"."contrato_minimo_dias" IS NOT NULL

commercial_metrics_disponivel_completa.name: commercial_metrics_disponivel_completa
commercial_metrics_disponivel_completa.value: "commercial_metrics"."status" = 'unavailable' OR ("commercial_metrics"."valor" IS NOT NULL AND "commercial_metrics"."periodo_inicio" IS NOT NULL AND "commercial_metrics"."periodo_fim" IS NOT NULL AND "commercial_metrics"."coletado_em" IS NOT NULL AND "commercial_metrics"."periodo_fim" >= "commercial_metrics"."periodo_inicio")

action_items_done_evidence_ck.name: action_items_done_evidence_ck
action_items_done_evidence_ck.value: "action_items"."status" <> 'done' OR ("action_items"."closed_at" IS NOT NULL AND "action_items"."evidence_ref" IS NOT NULL)

meeting_runs_reschedule_ck.name: meeting_runs_reschedule_ck
meeting_runs_reschedule_ck.value: ("meeting_runs"."rescheduled_date" IS NULL AND "meeting_runs"."reschedule_reason" IS NULL) OR ("meeting_runs"."rescheduled_date" IS NOT NULL AND "meeting_runs"."rescheduled_date" > "meeting_runs"."local_date" AND "meeting_runs"."reschedule_reason" IS NOT NULL AND "meeting_runs"."reschedule_reason" = 'holiday_move')

meeting_runs_reason_status_ck.name: meeting_runs_reason_status_ck
meeting_runs_reason_status_ck.value: ("meeting_runs"."status" = 'status_only' AND "meeting_runs"."reason" IS NOT NULL) OR ("meeting_runs"."status" <> 'status_only' AND "meeting_runs"."reason" IS NULL)
